sources.title: [2509.20021] Embodied AI: From LLMs to World Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: On the other hand, WMs empower embodied AI by building internal representations and future predictions of the external world, facilitating physical law-compliant embodied interactions. As such, this paper comprehensively explores the literature in embodied AI from basics to advances, covering both LLM driven and WM driven works.

sources.snippet: The paper explores the integration of Large Language Models and World Models in Embodied AI to enhance cognitive abilities and interactions in physical environments, proposing a joint architecture that leverages their complementary strengths for improved adaptability and performance in real-world applications.
